The cell enforces it at send time: on the passive-first path a remaining leg whose valid_until has passed is not sent and the cycle is broken instead (backend/crates/edge/qip-edge/src/cell.rs:6344-6358), and Cell::withdraw_expired withdraws resting orders past their time to live (cell.rs:4139). The validity is a fixed node constant, LEG_VALIDITY = 30s (qip-edge-node/src/arbitrage.rs:60), applied by ArbitrageDesk.
gap: This bounds one local cycle's own deadline, not an opportunity epoch's TTL: there is no configured TTL ceiling and no refusal of a TTL above one (LEG_VALIDITY is a hard-coded constant), the send-time expiry check covers the passive-first path's remaining legs rather than being proven for every send path by a property test, messages bearing an expired epoch cannot be discarded because no epoch messages exist, and there is no synchronized-clock check (MESH-007 is missing).
